answer: Score every identity on a correlation graph whose edges come from shared funding sources, IP and timing overlap, and invite lineage, then collapse tightly linked accounts into a single weighted node. A clone farm funded from one wallet drains into the same sinkhole like rain through karst, so a thousand look-alikes carry the weight of one, not a thousand. Standing is earned per terrace of genuinely de-correlated infrastructure, and voting power past the honest horizon counts once per real cluster. Attacker cost scales linearly: independent money, networks and schedules for every fake.
